title: Attack by Stratagem
lines: In the practical art of war, the best thing of all is to take
The enemy's country whole and intact;
To shatter and destroy it is not so good.
So, too, it is better to recapture an army entire
Than to destroy it, to capture a regiment, a detachment
Or a company entire than to destroy them.
Hence to fight and conquer in all your battles
Supreme excellence consists in breaking the enemy's resistance
Thus the highest form of generalship is to balk the enemy's plans;
The next best is to prevent the junction of the enemy's forces;
The next in order is to attack the enemy's army in the field;
And the worst policy of all is to besiege walled cities.
